features.quote: Classes with Arnaud DJBN, Ichigo, Manu & Olivia
features.rationale: The description lists dance classes with named teachers as part of the event.
Daytime socials are scheduled in the afternoon.
The event has three separate dance rooms.
A dress code is explicitly stated for the event.
The full pass price is given with accommodation included.

features.quote: with breakfasts included in rooms for 2 or 10 people
features.rationale: Breakfasts are included in the accommodation that comes with the pass.

features.quote: Shuttles will be provided for festival-goers arriving by train or plane on Friday and Sunday.
features.rationale: Shuttle transfers from train or plane are offered to attendees.
